name: papin-dashboard-uiux-automation
notes: Prefer deterministic runs with mocked auth responses for error/success branches.
Capture dialog events because LoginCard uses window.alert for feedback.
Avoid class-based selectors from Tailwind utility classes.

cases.title: Login page desktop render
assertions: heading Login is visible
identifier field is visible
submit button Masuk Ke Dashboard is visible
tabs LOGIN and REGISTER are visible

cases.title: Login page mobile no horizontal overflow
assertions: document.body.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth

cases.title: Switch login method pair code to password
assertions: secondary field label changes to Password
password placeholder is shown

cases.title: Switch login method password to pair code
assertions: secondary field label changes to Pair Code

cases.title: Pair code input normalized uppercase
steps: fill pair code input with ab12cd
assertions: pair code input value equals AB12CD

cases.title: Password eye toggle changes input type
assertions: input type changes password to text after first click
input type changes text to password after second click

cases.title: Login failure shows alert dialog
assertions: dialog alert appears with invalid credential message

cases.title: Login button loading state
assertions: button text changes to Authenticating during request
button text returns after request completes

cases.title: Navigate login to register tab
assertions: url path is /register
heading Register is visible

cases.title: Register stage 1 default state
assertions: badge Belum Buat Akun is visible
button Buat Akun is visible
button Saya Sudah Verifikasi is visible

cases.title: Create account success feedback
steps: fill email account and password account
assertions: dialog alert appears with verification instructions

cases.title: Verify button guard when not verified
assertions: dialog alert with verification error is shown
stage 2 setup profile section remains hidden

cases.title: Stage 2 profile setup visible when verified
assertions: section Tahap 2 - Setup Profile is visible

cases.title: Switch register mode pair now and solo
assertions: cta text updates to Daftar Berdua in pair mode
cta text updates to Daftar Sekarang in solo mode

cases.title: Partner gender locked opposite from user
steps: in Data Dirimu set gender A
assertions: partner gender field is read only
partner gender value equals Perempuan

cases.title: Agreement checkbox controls submit button
steps: observe submit button before checkbox checked
assertions: submit button is disabled before checkbox
submit button is enabled after checkbox

cases.title: Privacy summary tooltip appears on hover
assertions: tooltip with title Privacy Summary is visible

cases.title: Redirect to dashboard when session exists
assertions: current path changes to /dashboard
